title: 初二十空三选：兔子的绳结
instruction: 阅读下面完整寓言，从每题三个选项中为第1—10空各选最合适的一项。每题1.5分，共15分。
source_notice: 参照既存公开转载原PDF第7页初二C卷语言运用第一节：一篇寓言、十空、每空三独立候选、每题1.5分共15分。设置/审核校名只是原页署名，原校实际施测未认证；旧结构记录全输入为未知，本批核原完整页图并保存视觉转录，原36/40/43近义语用风险保留，原键非gold。另编三个不同的拟人动物故事，不复制原蚂蚁蚱蜢情节，寓言不作真实动物行为或普遍人生规律。逐候选回填为作者自审，独立教研、学生难度/用时、商用与生产未验证。

sections.label: A
sections.passage:
In a storybook village, Rabbit and Badger planned a puppet show. Rabbit could make beautiful puppets, while Badger knew how to hang a curtain. Rabbit wanted everyone to notice the puppets, so he spent most of the morning adding tiny buttons and hats. He gave (1) ____ thought to the curtain.

Badger asked for help carrying the curtain pole. "In a minute," Rabbit said. The minute became half an hour. Badger finally carried it alone, but could not hold both ends and tie the rope at the same time. He left the pole on the floor.

When the audience arrived, Rabbit was (2) ____ to find no curtain hanging. He began to blame Badger. Then he saw the heavy pole and understood what the earlier (3) ____ for help had meant.

Rabbit put down his puppets. Together, they lifted the pole. Rabbit held one end (4) ____ Badger tied the other. The curtain was soon ready, but the show had started late.

Afterwards, a small squirrel praised the puppets and asked why the curtain had been missing. Rabbit could have blamed his partner. (5) ____, he explained his own part in the delay.

Badger was pleased that Rabbit had told the (6) ____. They decided to prepare the next show with a list of jobs. Next to every task, they wrote whether one animal could finish it (7) ____ or whether two were needed.

For the next performance, Rabbit finished fewer tiny decorations. The puppets still looked lovely, and the curtain went up on (8) ____. From behind it, Rabbit gave Badger a quiet smile.

He had not become less interested in his own work. He had simply learned to notice what his own work (9) ____ on. When they packed up, Rabbit did not walk away with just his puppets. He stayed to help Badger (10) ____ the curtain.

questions.rationale: A：多数时间装饰小物，帘子未准备，little thought说明关注少；B：他没响应需要帮忙，非已仔细考虑整体幕布；C：投入大部分精力人偶，与equal均等考虑不合
A：certain to find表示肯定将发现，不符合此处已经看到后才意识的反应；B：到观众到场才发现没挂帘，与之前未关注相应；C：ready to find不表达意外发现没挂帘的情绪
A：实际一人无法吊杆系绳，不是玩笑；B：Badger早先叫帮搬杆，是请求援助；C：不是奖品或获奖公告
A：两人同时分工，他扶一端时同伴系另一端；B：两人协作非相互让步矛盾，while直接说明同时动作；C：除非对方系另一端才不扶不符合一起操作
A：解释自己与责怪对方不是相似处理；B：Otherwise表示否则的另一后果，与已选择诚实说明不合；C：没甩锅而选择解释自己失误，是替代可能的责怪
A：tell the difference是辨别异同，不是此处承认实情；B：tell the time指报时，未问钟点；C：诚实说明自己延误，不再嫁祸，tell truth合适
A：与是否需两人对比，是否能独立完成；B：与两人需求相对的不是再做一次；C：与两人需求相对的不是户外做
A：on time表示准时，呼应第一次迟开；B：帘子不是上架销售，不能总结演出准时；C：on purpose表示故意，不表达第二次按时开始
A：其他工作本身不嘲笑人偶装饰；B：工作不能表示人与人意见不一致；C：人偶顺利表演依赖幕布等配套，不能只顾自己的装饰
A：give up the curtain表示放弃，不是收起供以后用；B：演出后卸下幕布，与收拾场地一致；C：put off the curtain不表示卸下幕布
